shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat vertical stone slab/panel
horizontal register bands dividing the composition
repeated row of similar motifs forming a frieze
justification: Both surfaces are flat slabs bearing low relief organised into horizontal registers with profile figures, and both include repeated rows of like motifs, but that is about as generic as relief conventions get. A shows two facing human figures in courtly interaction with garments, bracelets, a bowl, a bow and a dagger, rendered with fine naturalistic detail, whereas B shows only schematic animals — a crouching quadruped, birds, a large long-necked bird below — with no human figures, no interaction between them, and a wholly different, blocky abstract idiom.
